newsitem.title: FRANCE: Cades plans taps of existing 3 Ffr bonds - sources.
newsitem.headline: Cades plans taps of existing 3 Ffr bonds - sources.

text.p: French welfare debt repayment fund CADES plans to issue more of its existing three lines of French franc bonds next Wednesday, market sources said on Tuesday.
They said CADES had sent out a fax to primary dealers stating its intentions. It plans to sell the bonds, maturing in 2002, 2005 and 2007, by auction to primary dealers.
The fund did not give any target size for the sale but said it wanted to sell a minimum of one billion in each line, the market sources said.
No one at CADES was immediately available for comment.
